spans.text: [2] AR: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter.

spans.text: [7] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ EN: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.

spans.text: [2] AR: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter.

[15] AR: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ EN: O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

folded.id: whom he|wills|and guides whom he wills
folded.subject: whom He

spans.text: For indeed, Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills.

folded.id: you|can|only warn those who fear their lord unseen and have established prayer
folded.subject: You
folded.object: only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer

spans.text: You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer.
